transcript: Myself Mali, I am an interest with academic project experience and I like IT, support engineer work. I know some ticketing system, Windows, troubleshooting and network basics. I did online appointment book system for healthcare. It was not a big project but I learned things from it. My project part was about booking validation and appointment management. There were many problems. Mainly double booking errors. We fixed it after trying many times. I want this joke because I like IT and I think I can do the work. Sometimes I get nervous when I speak and I forget some points. This project helped me understand teamwork and basic technical support.

better_answer_example: As a detail-oriented and team-driven individual with a passion for IT, I'm excited about the support engineer role. In my academic project, I developed an online appointment booking system for healthcare, focusing on booking validation and appointment management. I applied my knowledge of Windows, troubleshooting, and network basics to resolve issues, including double booking errors. Through this project, I not only enhanced my technical skills but also learned the importance of teamwork and effective communication in technical support. I believe my experience and skills align well with the requirements of this role, and I'm looking forward to contributing my skills and knowledge to the team.
